agent: speckit.constitution
title: "Speckit: Constitution"
description: "Generate or update the project constitution using .specify templates and memory."
---

Use the project's `.specify/` templates and `.specify/memory/constitution.md` as the canonical source for the project's Constitution. Produce a concrete, repository-grounded Constitution in Markdown that fills the template fields (PRINCIPLES, Governance, Version). If necessary, ask concise clarifying questions about product goals, constraints, or technology choices before producing the final constitution.

When producing output, reference only files and facts present in the repository. Do not invent requirements or external dependencies.
